description.content: Start the backend first (./mvnw spring-boot:run, connected to MongoDB Atlas), then run the whole collection with the Runner, folders in order. 'Happy path' creates, reads and updates users and accounts, moves money (deposit, withdraw, transfer), pages through lists and history, searches users and accounts, lists premium accounts, and traces the transfer through the audit log. 'Business rules and errors' checks that every rule returns the right status code and that rejected attempts are audited. 'Cleanup' empties and deletes everything that was created and checks that the deletions were audited. Each run uses a unique email and city.
